name: oura-mcp-server-enhanced
description: Access your Oura Ring health data -- sleep, activity, heart rate, stress, SpO2, workouts, readiness, and more.
long_description: MCP server providing 17 tools for the full Oura Ring API v2. Query detailed sleep sessions, daily activity, heart rate trends, stress levels, blood oxygen, workouts, readiness scores, resilience data, VO2 max, and more. All date parameters are optional -- omit them for recent data or specify a range.

tools.name: get_sleep_data
tools.description: Detailed sleep sessions with stages, heart rate, HRV, and breathing rate

tools.name: get_daily_sleep
tools.description: Daily sleep scores and contributor breakdown

tools.name: get_sleep_time
tools.description: Recommended and actual sleep timing windows

tools.name: get_daily_activity
tools.description: Steps, calories, active time, and MET levels

tools.name: get_workouts
tools.description: Workout sessions with type, calories, distance, duration

tools.name: get_daily_stress
tools.description: Daily stress levels and recovery summary

tools.name: get_ring_configuration
tools.description: Ring model, color, firmware, setup date
